description: Implementation of QuicCryptoClientHandshaker class handling QUIC handshake logic, including proof verification, message processing, and state transitions.

classes.name: ProofVerifierCallbackImpl
classes.description: Callback implementation for proof verification results, manages callback execution and state updates.

classes.name: QuicCryptoClientHandshaker
classes.description: Handles the QUIC client handshake process, including message exchange, proof verification, and state management.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Callback invoked upon proof verification completion, updates parent state and proceeds with handshake.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels the proof verification callback, nullifying parent reference.

methods.name: QuicCryptoClientHandshaker
methods.description: Constructor initializing handshake state with server info, session, config, and proof handler.

methods.name: ~QuicCryptoClientHandshaker
methods.description: Destructor that cancels proof verification callback if active.

methods.name: OnHandshakeMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming handshake messages, handling server config updates and message flow control.

methods.name: CryptoConnect
methods.description: Starts the handshake process, returns connection status.

methods.name: num_sent_client_hellos
methods.description: Returns the number of client hello messages sent.

methods.name: IsResumption
methods.description: Indicates whether handshake is a session resumption (always false in this implementation).

methods.name: EarlyDataAccepted
methods.description: Checks if early data was accepted based on handshake state.

methods.name: EarlyDataReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for early data status.

methods.name: ReceivedInchoateReject
methods.description: Indicates if an inchoate reject has been received.

methods.name: num_scup_messages_received
methods.description: Returns count of server config update messages received.

methods.name: chlo_hash
methods.description: Returns the hash of the client hello message.

methods.name: encryption_established
methods.description: Indicates if encryption has been established.

methods.name: IsCryptoFrameExpectedForEncryptionLevel
methods.description: Indicates if a crypto frame is expected for a given encryption level.

methods.name: GetEncryptionLevelToSendCryptoDataOfSpace
methods.description: Determines the encryption level for sending crypto data in a given packet space.

methods.name: one_rtt_keys_available
methods.description: Checks if 1-RTT keys are available.

methods.name: crypto_negotiated_params
methods.description: Returns negotiated cryptographic parameters.

methods.name: crypto_message_parser
methods.description: Returns the crypto message parser.

methods.name: GetHandshakeState
methods.description: Returns current handshake state.

methods.name: OnHandshakeDoneReceived
methods.description: Placeholder for handling handshake completion.

methods.name: OnNewTokenReceived
methods.description: Placeholder for handling new token reception.

methods.name: BufferSizeLimitForLevel
methods.description: Returns buffer size limit for a given encryption level.

methods.name: AdvanceKeysAndCreateCurrentOneRttDecrypter
methods.description: Creates decrypter for current 1-RTT keys (not implemented).

methods.name: CreateCurrentOneRttEncrypter
methods.description: Creates encrypter for current 1-RTT keys (not implemented).

methods.name: OnConnectionClosed
methods.description: Handles connection closure, updates handshake state.

methods.name: HandleServerConfigUpdateMessage
methods.description: Processes server config update message.

methods.name: DoHandshakeLoop
methods.description: Main handshake state machine loop, transitions between states.

methods.name: DoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes handshake, verifies cached config or proceeds to send hello.

methods.name: DoSendCHLO
methods.description: Constructs and sends client hello message, manages handshake retries.

methods.name: DoReceiveREJ
methods.description: Handles server rejection message, updates state accordingly.

methods.name: DoVerifyProof
methods.description: Performs proof verification asynchronously.

methods.name: DoVerifyProofComplete
methods.description: Completes proof verification, updates handshake state based on result.

methods.name: DoReceiveSHLO
methods.description: Processes server hello message, finalizes handshake.

methods.name: DoInitializeServerConfigUpdate
methods.description: Handles server config update message.

methods.name: SetCachedProofValid
methods.description: Marks cached proof as valid and notifies proof handler.
